industryPackIngestion.failureReason: S3 Vectors filterable metadata 2048 bytes limit exceeded. Documents with long SID lists (multiple domain SIDs) fail to index.
industryPackIngestion.resolution: Reduce metadata size by shortening SID list or using group-level SIDs instead of individual user SIDs

failClosedPrinciple.description: Documents without .metadata.json (allowed_group_sids) are excluded from RAG responses
failClosedPrinciple.evidence: Query returned 'no permission' message when metadata SIDs don't match user SIDs

modelUsed.description: Nova 2 Lite JP Inference Profile correctly used as fallback model (Phase 0 model update confirmed)
modelUsed.note: To test Prompt Caching, Smart Routing must be ON to route to Claude Sonnet 4.6 or Opus 4.8

sidFilterCommaSeparated.description: parseDocumentSIDs now correctly splits comma-separated SID strings. Lambda redeployed.
sidFilterCommaSeparated.nextStep: Send query again to verify Permission filter passes with metadata-matched documents

permissionFilterPass.description: After SID filter fix + metadata bulk upload, RAG correctly returns document content with 6 cited sources
permissionFilterPass.evidence: ESG report content returned with file citations (reports/esg/*, uploads/*, reports/utilities/*)

promptCaching.description: Prompt Caching mechanism is correctly implemented (caching enabled log + EMF metrics emitted). However, Nova 2 Lite does not support Prompt Caching. Cache hits will only occur with Claude models.
promptCaching.reason: Nova 2 Lite (Amazon model) does not support Bedrock Prompt Caching. Claude models required for actual cache hits.

smartRouting.description: Smart Routing toggle works (aria-checked=true) but model auto-selection requires a model to be selected in UI first. When no model selected, fallback (Nova 2 Lite) is always used.
smartRouting.reason: UI shows "モデルが選択されていません" - auto mode needs a base model selection to override
smartRouting.note: Smart Router backend logic is confirmed working (code + property tests). UI integration tested.

permissionDifference.description: Admin user (SIDs include S-1-1-0) gets document access. Regular user (SID S-1-5-21-999-1001 only) gets DENY. Permission isolation confirmed.
permissionDifference.evidence: DynamoDB SID data vs document metadata comparison

bugfix.issue: SID filter parseDocumentSIDs did not handle comma-separated string format
bugfix.fix: Added comma split in string fallback path of parseDocumentSIDs()
bugfix.status: Fixed and redeployed. Lambda updated with latest digest.

findings.title: Citation file names show UUID-based S3 keys instead of human-readable names
findings.description: KB data source contains auto-generated JSON files with UUID filenames (e.g., reports/esg/2026-06-06/5578ceee-ac4d-4bb7-a431-d82afed79f04.json). The citation display shows these raw S3 keys which are not user-friendly.
findings.recommendation: Extract document title or use_case from JSON content to display as citation label. Fallback to filename if metadata unavailable.

findings.title: Smart Routing auto mode requires initial model selection
findings.description: When Smart Routing is ON but no model is selected in the UI, the system falls back to Nova 2 Lite instead of auto-selecting based on query complexity.
findings.recommendation: Auto-select default model (e.g., Sonnet 4.6) when Smart Routing is enabled and no model is explicitly chosen.
